utterances.speaker: JUDGE ORIE
utterances.text: Good afternoon to everyone. Madam Registrar, would you please call the case.

utterances.speaker: THE REGISTRAR
utterances.text: Good afternoon, Your Honours. This is case number IT-06-90-T, the Prosecutor versus Gotovina, et al.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE ORIE
utterances.text: Thank you, Madam Registrar. If there are no procedural matters to be raised, Ms. Mahindaratne, may I take it that you want to continue your examination on subjects for which we'd have to move into private session.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE ORIE
utterances.text: Then we move into private session, and the usher is invited to escort the witness into the courtroom.

utterances.speaker: MS. MAHINDARATNE
utterances.text: Mr. President while the witness is coming in, I just wanted to inform the Court that I received --

utterances.speaker: MS. MAHINDARATNE
utterances.text: I beg your pardon, Madam Registrar. I just wanted to inform Court that I did check the evidence of the citations I gave yesterday with regard to Witness 82, and I don't find any inaccuracies that are cited.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE ORIE
utterances.text: Yes. I checked that as well. What we see as a matter of fact that the witness said that on their way to Donji Lapac that he saw 90 per cent destroyed. At other moments, he talks about coming from Gracac but the direct link between the 90 per cent and the route, Gracac-Donji Lapac, is not there, from what I see. And that may have caused the objection.

utterances.speaker: MR. KUZMANOVIC
utterances.text: That's correct, Your Honour, and that's the point I was going to make after counsel graciously gave me the citations, and I looked at them myself as well.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE ORIE
utterances.text: Yes. And so the 90 per cent is there, Donji Lapac as a destination is there, Gracac, at another moment as where the -- they departed from is there, but the 90 per cent for that trajectory from Gracac to Donji Lapac is -- I haven't found it, and I have verified all the quotations you gave.

utterances.speaker: MS. MAHINDARATNE
utterances.text: Mr. President, if that's the case, my apologies.

utterances.speaker: MS. MAHINDARATNE
utterances.text: to be reconvened on Friday, the 26th day of March, 2010, at 9.00 a.m.

procedural_notes.text: [Private session] [Confidentiality partially lifted by order of Chamber]
--- Whereupon the hearing adjourned at 7.00 p.m.,
